notes.title: 🌈Pride Month Mermaid Sale + Hopeful News from Japan
notes.content:
🌈Pride Month Mermaid Sale + Hopeful News from Japan

[h2]TL;DR:[/h2] (I hope you'll read 'cause I've spent a lot of time writing it🥺🙏)
1. The Pride Month🌈 Mermaid Sale is live now!
2. Mizuchi was briefly ranked 5th in Adventure at a Japanese chain store!
3. And… wishlist Red Rebellion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35533250/9c284a31a32aa36acb18388602cdc935f622615d.png[/img]

[i]Disclosure: This announcement is written by a fan volunteer. Any excessive excitement does not reflect the character of our writer.[/i]

[h2]1. Pride Month Mermaid Sale is live now![/h2]
To celebrate Pride Month and all your queerness, the game is now on discount! In these uncertain times, we hope you all stay safe and live the lives you truly deserve!

Discount here:🔽
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121300/Mizuchi/

[Editor: Why mermaid sale? I've been told mermaid yuri is trending now. And we have a mermaid in the game. Might be a good marketing tactic?🤷‍♀️]

[h2]2. Mizuchi was briefly ranked 5th in Adventure at Yodobashi, a popular Japanese chain store![/h2]

We are super thrilled to find that Mizuchi may be doing well in Japan! Look at its ranking in the Adventure category at Yodobashi!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35533250/4a6cc585e053edc9cf84323944224b5393fb0e87.png[/img]
🔼5th! Mizuchi ranked 5th!

Though the rankings do fluctuate, it’s both surreal and amusing to see Mizuchi side by side with bigger games. 

🔽We were even next to Hello Kitty for a moment!🤯
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35533250/e29cf56e8ba06979e8e23936b51710f78d928265.png[/img]

If you want a physical copy, grab yours here!🔽
[url=https://mizuchigame.com/en/#buy-game]https://mizuchigame.com/en/#buy-game[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35533250/3a89092b613f3af1d244bd0d127a0c7cdbb688d5.png[/img]
🔼These pictures were sent in by fans/friends from Japan. It’s moving to see Mizuchi on the shelves. Thank you so much!😭

[h2]3. Wishlist Red Rebellion![/h2]

Red Rebellion is the second game written by the same writer. It features an even larger LGBTQIA+ friendly cast!

Not only will you receive an email notification when the game launches, but you'll also be [b]helping us[/b] tremendously to push the [b]Steam god[/b] (algorithm) to introduce the game to more gamers like you. Thank you to all those who already did so! 💙

[b]Wishlist Red Rebellion:[/b]🔽
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2114160/Red_Rebellion/

Thank you for being part of this journey with us.

notes.title: Our 5-year Anniversary Sale Begins + News regarding Japan, Hong Kong & UK!
notes.content:
[h2]TL;DR:[/h2]
1. Mizuchi's 5-year anniversary sale is live! 💵🈹!
2. Mizuchis' physical console release in Japan on May 15th!
3. Mizuchi & Red Rebellion made appearances in Hong Kong and London!
4. And… wishlist Red Rebellion! 🥺

[i]Disclosure: This announcement is written by a fan volunteer. You may see overexcitement, which does not reflect the character of our writer.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35533250/0c8162379c7ae4ec7cc2698d733e9070c48d8166.png[/img]

[h2]1. The 5-year anniversary sale begins![/h2]

We can't believe 5 years have gone by since Mizuchi was released! Time sure flies!

Mizuchi has received some extremely nice new Steam reviews since the last update. Thank you so much! We want to let you know that [b]we always read them all, and it makes us feel warm and fuzzy inside[/b]. ♨️🥺*wink*

“It’s a [b]must-buy[/b] for visual novel fans, yuri fans, or anyone just looking for a good game to play…Overall: A” – [url=https://a-to-jconnections.com/gaming/wasted-days-sleepless-nights-a-mizuchi-review]A-to-J Connections[/url]

To celebrate the 5-year anniversary (and the fact that Mizuchi is a must-buy 😳), the game is now on discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121300/Mizuchi/

[h2]2. Physical console release of Mizuchi in Japan on May 15th![/h2]

At first, we all thought it was going to be released last year along with the Asia version. And then we waited… and waited.. and waited… and then one day, it suddenly appeared for pre-purchase on multiple big sites in Japan! It's REAL! The release date is in one month on May 15th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35533250/37884c1e053cdd35265c3bf36df67393da0bbeec.png[/img]

[url=https://mizuchigame.com/ja/#buy-game]Links to pre-order[/url] (unless you click it after May 15th, then it will be links to order)

[h2]3. Mizuchi and Red Rebellion appeared in Hong Kong and London![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35533250/f9a99ba436bbf491c930ed7cb7ad963dfff0945a.png[/img]

On April 3-4, Red Rebellion made a cameo in Cyber Paradise at London Games Festival! If you didn't fly over to London and missed it, this crossover is now available in Cyber Paradise's online demo too!

Check it out!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431790/Cyber_Paradise

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35533250/58e9c6c9fdb903c59a582155782007f49cfafda9.jpg[/img]

Immediately afterward on April 5th, our artist Nalcyon and her team iBOOM Creative brought Mizuchi and Red Rebellion to an exhibition in Hong Kong!

Check out their work: https://iboomcreative.com/

[h2]4. Last But Not Least: Please Wishlist Red Rebellion![/h2]

Not only will you receive an email notification when the game launches, but you'll also be [b]helping us[/b] tremendously to push the [b]Steam god[/b] (algorithm) to introduce the game to more gamers like you. Thank you to all those that already did so! 💙

[b]Wishlist Red Rebellion:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2114160/Red_Rebellion/

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Now Live – Start Collecting!
notes.content:
[h2]TL;DR:[/h2]
1. Mizuchi's Steam [b]trading card[/b] is now live - fire up the game and start collecting!
2. A guide to Mizuchi's [b]5 endings[/b]. Did you know all endings work together to give you a [b]satisfying emotional closure[/b]?😊
3. Mizuchi's [b]physical console release[/b] in Asia!
4. Language updates! [b]Chinese and Japanese[/b] are coming soon.
5. [b]Wishlist our upcoming game[/b] - Red Rebellion.

[i]Disclosure: This announcement is written by a fan volunteer. You may see overexcitement in the choice of words, which does not reflect the character of our writer - who's always way too modest.[/i]🤦‍♀️

[h2]1. Mizuchi's Steam trading cards are now live![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35533250/4b1d801c3eb28aa5dfa9c526412a478ab1aef094.png[/img]

One day, when casually browsing Mizuchi's Steam backend, our dev noticed something unusual- the button "trading card" was no longer greyed out. Wow! Mizuchi was now eligible for trading card drop! How nice! So, yeah, the team quickly designed the cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35533250/b877a2a710253223768de0c71ecb71774f060017.png[/img]

You can get 7 or 8 free card drops just by playing the game. Along with the card update, we've also fixed some text and added some extra stuff. If you haven't finished the game, [b]NOW is the time to jump back in![/b]

[h2]2. A guide to Mizuchi's [b]5 endings[/b]. Did you know all endings work together to give you a satisfying emotional closure?[/h2]

As a super fan, let me tell you—if you haven’t played through all the routes, you haven’t experienced the full emotional impact of the story and got all the mystery tied up.

I'm not making this up. Another critic had a similar thought - “[b]There are many layers of meaning, and it’s nice to ponder them after playing…it will leave an imprint on my gamer heart.[/b] (translated from French)”– [url=https://jrpgfr.net/2025/02/10/test-de-mizuchi-une-histoire-incroyable-et-le-reste/]JRPGFR[/url]

I know figuring out all the endings can be a mystery. We're lucky because one of our early players has whipped up a guide:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2328927189]https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2328927189[/url]

[h2]3. Mizuchi's physical console release in Asia![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35533250/05551e350f6fd300633af429bbffe011b1247683.png[/img]

It’s surreal to see a physical copy of Mizuchi finally in the hands of one of our teammates!

This wouldn’t have been possible without the support from our early fans. It must have been your many positive reviews that helped our game get noticed by our console publishers! So... a big thank you💖!

If you want to grab a copy…👉[url=https://mizuchigame.com/]https://mizuchigame.com/[/url]

BTW, did you know that [b]more reviews on Steam[/b] can also help Mizuchi reach more gamers? *wink* *wink*😉

[h2]4. Language updates! Chinese and Japanese are coming soon.  [/h2]

Due to our agreement with our console publishers and the Japanese version being released in the upcoming May, the Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese languages will be exclusive to console for a short duration. But we can assure you they'll be available on Steam in the near future as we are making time to check that the new build works properly. We'll make another announcement when the release date is confirmed!

If you want to pre-order the Japanese version, check out the purchase section at [url=https://mizuchigame.com/]https://mizuchigame.com/[/url]

[h2]5. Wishlist our upcoming game - Red Rebellion.[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2114160/Red_Rebellion/

A sapphic fairy tale mashup as Robin Hood teams up with Red Riding Hood to save their town, in this yuri / lesbian historical fantasy set in medieval England.

This time, there’s even more gameplay alongside the same good (if not better) storytelling in Mizuchi.

So, wishlist it now!

notes.title: Limited Time Mizuchi Merchandise Preorder and Soundtrack Release
notes.content:
[h1]Merchandise[/h1]

We have been slow and busy trying to get multiple things done, so our sincerest apologies for the delay in the news. We wanted to mention that the official Aikasa Collective store is open. If you missed out on the Kickstarter for Mizuchi physical merchandise before, this is your chance to order some of the limited edition items until [b]November 17th, 2021[/b]! Since the merchandise is a preorder run, we have no plans to produce any more merchandise in the future once we're out of stock. Feel free to check out our store: [url=http://aikasacollective.com/shop/]http://aikasacollective.com/shop/[/url]

[url=http://aikasacollective.com/shop/]http://aikasacollective.com/shop/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35533250/fa13a9465fbe61b9f25b40fa5a5753404ec7afd4.png[/img][/url]
Some examples of our merch: Official Artbook (illustrations, sketches, commentary), keychains, and character stand. We have mostly Asia-character style goods. No physical CD or OST due to damage risks in the mail.


[h1]Mizuchi Soundtrack[/h1]

We are happy to announce we are offering the Mizuchi all-original soundtrack of 15 songs and 2 additional bonus tracks! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811570/Mizuchi__Soundtrack/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811570/Mizuchi__Soundtrack/[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811570/Mizuchi__Soundtrack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35533250/ef6b2b2a46f8f66708b0d130b06e165d85c959ce.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Localization News[/h1]

So.... nothing has changed in getting Chinese (simplified and traditional) out, but there have definitely been a few hiccups / glitches in getting it to work properly on the build. It's the next focus now that merchandise is just about to finish up, so thank you for your patience. We are also in discussion with a publisher, who is also offering a few other languages to localize, as well as translation company LQA check. So we'll see how things pan out. Otherwise, for time constraints, we may just go with our current translator for the Chinese PC Steam release first and update later if there are big text changes. We are absolutely sorry for the delay on this, but hope to provide you a quality translated game when ready.

Thank you for your time!
